Bonito's crystal rivers, priced in 20 seconds: from US$ 13 a day 🐠
🚌 Bus from Campo Grande: R$ 120–129 (≈ US$ 22–23), 4–5 h
🌿 Eco tax: R$ 15 (≈ US$ 3) per person per day, paid online
🏊 Balneário Municipal: R$ 70–98 (≈ US$ 13–18)
💙 Gruta do Lago Azul cave: R$ 120–180 (≈ US$ 22–32)
🤿 Rio da Prata snorkel: R$ 470–570 (≈ US$ 85–103)
🍛 Self-service lunch: R$ 25–35 (≈ US$ 5–6)
🎟️ Tours only with a voucher from a local agency: book early
